title: Attestation Envelope v1
description: The detached-signature envelope that wraps a portable_artifact or render_trace. Sigstore / Certificate-Transparency family — explicitly NOT a blockchain. Machine-readable form of docs/oss/contracts/portable-artifact-v1.md §4; canonical source src/tp_vrg/attestation.py.

attestation_version.description: Envelope format version. Reject anything but 1 within this contract.

payload_type.description: Which payload contract the `payload` conforms to.

payload.description: The artifact, verbatim. Validate separately against the payload schema named by payload_type.

payload_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical-JSON serialization of `payload`.

signed_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 UTC instant the envelope was signed.

signed_by.description: did:web identifier or operator label. Identity trust requires resolving this against a did:web document — the envelope alone does not prove who signed.

key_id.description: ed25519:<first-16-hex of sha256 over the raw public key>.

public_key.description: base64 raw Ed25519 public key (32 bytes), embedded for offline integrity checks.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical-JSON protected header (every field except payload + signature).
